evidence.detail: oracle_id was added to the cards DB and emitted in /api/cardfeed (partial progress), but cards table still keyed by name
oracle_id is stored in card_values but the cards dict in multiverse is still keyed by name (e.g. set_legal_cards_async matches by row['name'])
Meld result specialcase code still exists; issue requests oracle_id as key would simplify this

triage.notes: Changing the primary key of the cards table from name to oracle_id would touch multiverse, oracle, legality, and likely require a DB migration; scope is well beyond 150 lines and needs design decisions about how melds and faces are handled.
